_readme: Per-locality search overrides, keyed by slug and merged over the matching record from data/locations/*.json at build time (see localityPages in build-pages.js). seoTitle replaces the generated <title> and must fit 60 characters; metaDesc replaces the regional file's description and must fit 155; heroCta is an [href, label] pair rendered as the primary button in the page header. Kept in one small file so a weekly Search Console pulse touches this rather than a 90 KB regional file. Every key must be a real locality slug — the build throws otherwise. No prices, no delivery timeframes.
